projects.title: Still Time
projects.problem: Solving the repetitive task of settings -> display -> Screen timeout to perform a screen contactless task out of a sudden and again going same to revert back, long, irritative repeating task.
projects.solution: Created an android app StillTime that reduces the interface between user and that settings making user usefully change screen timeout supporting lock mode for occasional longer screen timeouts.
highlights: Modular component-driven architecture using react native
Using system permission for writing screen timeout time
Don't ask for other permissions and is not possess security issues.
projects.description: Android buries it under Settings → Display. Stilltime puts a dial on it — 15 seconds to 1 hour, the whole circle — writes the value through the documented system API, then reads it back to prove it stuck.

developer.name: Nishan Rajak
about: I am a Computer Science undergraduate focused on backend engineering and production-oriented software development.
I build REST APIs and full-stack systems using TypeScript, Node.js, Bun, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, and Docker.
My work focuses on API architecture, authentication and authorization, database-backed systems, caching, background processing, integrations, testing, and deployment.
I enjoy understanding systems at the implementation level and improving reliability, performance, maintainability, and failure handling.
My recent work includes e-commerce, GitHub automation, GraphRAG, gym management, IoT/embedded applications, and other full-stack systems.
